title: Rename `UpsertNode` to `Node` and `Node` to `VettedNode` in the graph store
body:
## Changelog Entry

No changelog entry. This is a type-only rename inside the non-shipping `botframework-webchat-store` package from #6053 (label `no-changelog`).

## Description

For #6053. This renames the public node types in `packages/store`:

| Before | After | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UpsertNode<T>` | `Node<T>` | Validates the shape of a node you write, e.g. what an `upsert()` updater returns |
| `Node` | `VettedNode` | A read-only node that has passed `nodeSchema`, as returned by the store |

```ts
import type { Node, VettedNode } from 'botframework-webchat-store';

controller.edit(transaction =>
  transaction.upsert('_:m-1', (node: VettedNode | undefined): Node<{ text: string[] }> => ({
    '@id': '_:m-1',
    '@type': new Set(['Message']),
    text: ['Hello']
  }))
);
```

This PR targets the `feat-new-store` branch (#6053).

## Specific Changes

- **`src/node/Node.ts`**: both types are renamed. The JSDoc now uses the new names. The file name and `nodeSchema` stay the same.
- **`src/index.ts`**: now exports `type Node, type VettedNode`, sorted by name.
- **Store API** (`Store.ts`): `upsert()` takes `(node: VettedNode | undefined) => Node<T>`. `getSnapshot()`, `getSortedParts()` and `queryByIdentifier()` return `VettedNode`.
- **Internal usages**: updated in `assertion/*`, `private/identifierIndex.ts`, the comments in `private/FrozenNode.ts`, `benchmark.ts` and `Store.test.ts`.
- **Needs a human edit:** `src/goldenStories/upsertedNodeIsDifferentAndFrozen.test.ts` still imports `UpsertNode`. That folder is human-only under `goldenStories/AGENTS.md`, so this PR leaves it alone. Until it is updated by hand, `precommit:typecheck` fails with `TS2305: Module '"../index.ts"' has no exported member 'UpsertNode'`. The tests still pass because `node --test` strips type imports.
